gloss: lined up one after another; crowded together

definitions.gloss: lined up one after another; packed together
definitions.explanation: Of events, people, or things: crowded together in large numbers, one after another. Most often said of a busy schedule of events or attractions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目白押|めじろお}しだ。
examples.english: There are events lined up all weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目白押|めじろお}しで⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the year I'm busy with one year-end party after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目白押|めじろお}しで、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧しまう。
examples.english: This summer so many much-talked-about films are coming out that I can't decide what to see.

notes:
From the way ⟦メジロ→メジロ：32314_mejiro⟧ (Japanese white-eyes) perch packed side by side on a branch, pushing against each other.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目白押|めじろお}しだ: ... are lined up one after another
- {目白押|めじろお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: a packed (schedule, lineup)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盛|も}りだくさん→盛りだくさん：15482_moridakusan⟧: full of content; a rich program
- ⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧: to happen one after another (often of unwelcome events)
